verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents virtual card issuance and merchant, category, and merchant-ID blocking. However, nothing in the pack describes single-use cards, locking a card to one merchant, or exact-amount limits. Merchant blocking is an adjacent control (a deny-list, not a lock to one merchant), and the external authorization endpoint is only a building block a developer could use to construct such logic, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue single-use and tightly scoped cards — one purchase, one merchant, an exact amount — so a leaked number is worthless the moment it's used
